evidence: Library shows 6 template cards (Professional Resume, Professional Email, Weekly Status Report, Meeting Minutes, Project Proposal, Academic Research Summary), each with author name and description text.
Each card shows title (h3), author, description, category tag, scenario tag, usage count (e.g. "1,250 uses"), and update date (e.g. "Updated 2024-12-01").

Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opened a dialog with template details (title, category, scenario, description, author, uses) and a "Fill Template" tab containing the form fields, plus a "Preview Result" tab.

With all fields empty, dialog shows "Required fields missing" and lists them: "Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills". Preview Result tab is disabled.

All 14 fields of the Professional Resume template (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) were fillable via textboxes.

After filling required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and clicking it rendered the resume with entered values substituted (name, job title, summary, company, position, dates, responsibilities, degree, school, year, skills).
Preview of Professional Resume (Markdown template) shows h1/h2/h3 headings, a separator, bold (strong) and italic (emphasis) text correctly rendered with all placeholders replaced by entered values.

Markdown template preview rendered headings, bold, italics, and separators correctly after substitution (verified on Professional Resume). Plain text case to be cross-checked with custom template test.

actual: Entered "not-an-email" (invalid email format) into the required Email field; the Preview Result tab became enabled and the preview rendered "not-an-email" verbatim without any validation error, instead of rejecting the value or keeping preview unavailable.

evidence: Clearing the required "Full Name" field showed "Required fields missing: Please fill in: Full Name" and disabled the Preview Result tab; refilling it re-enabled the tab.

Entering special characters "** # [link](javascript:alert(1)) ---" into Full Name triggered inline error "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed" and kept Preview Result tab disabled.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" showed a toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied." and button text changed to "Copied!".

Clicked favorite icons on Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes cards; Favorites button count updated 0→1→2. Clicking "Favorites" button opened a favorites-only view showing "Showing 2 of 6 templates" with only the two favorited templates.
Favoriting updated the header "Favorites" button badge count immediately (0→1→2) without reload, and toggled active state on the card's favorite button.
While in favorites-only view (2 favorites), typing "Meeting" in the search box narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6 templates" showing only Meeting Minutes.
Typing "Resu" (4 chars) showed a real-time suggestion "Professional Resume"; clicking it filled the search box with "Professional Resume" and narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6 templates".

issue: Search does not tolerate typos / no fuzzy matching
actual: Searching "Meting" (typo for "Meeting") and "Resme" (typo for "Resume") both returned "Showing 0 of 6 templates" / "No templates found", with no suggestions and no matching template surfaced, instead of returning or suggesting the intended template.

evidence: Category filter "Resume" narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter "Academic" narrowed to 1/6; Sort "Alphabetical" reordered cards alphabetically (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report); "Most Popular" sorted descending by usage count.
All filter/search/sort/favorites interactions updated the "Showing X of 6 templates" count and card list instantly in the DOM without any page navigation/reload.

Submitting blank form showed "Missing required fields: Please fill in all required fields." Submitting with title/author/description/content filled but no defined field showed "No fields defined: Please add at least one template field."

issue: Field-to-placeholder mapping not enforced on submission
actual: Submitted a custom template ("Simple Note") with a defined field "Note Text" ({{note_text}}) that was never referenced in the Template Content (content had no {{note_text}} placeholder). The submission succeeded without any validation error, instead of being blocked for the unmapped field/placeholder mismatch.

evidence: Submitted a custom Markdown template "Simple Note" with title, description, author, category (Other), scenario (Business), content, and one defined field ("Note Text"). Toast confirmed "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."
After submitting, "Showing 7 of 7 templates" appeared instantly (was 6 of 6) with the new "Simple Note" card visible, without any page reload/navigation.
The custom "Simple Note" template appeared in the library, could be selected via "Use Template", its form ("Note Text" field) was fillable, and Preview Result rendered the content correctly.

issue: Duplicate field labels not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Added two template fields both labeled "name" (both mapping to placeholder {{name}}) to the "Dup Test Template" submission form; both duplicate fields were accepted into the field list without warning, and the template submitted successfully ("Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."), with the library showing 8 of 8 templates including the new card — instead of being rejected or disambiguated.

evidence: After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, Favorites button still shows count "2" (previously favorited Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes), and the Filters sidebar shows "Showing 8 of 8 templates" including both custom-submitted templates "Dup Test Template" and "Simple Note" still visible as cards in the library — all persisted across reload.
